answer: Every new identity enters through one narrow inlet and pays a 30 POA sybil tax, burned, never refunded. The fee is a ledge, too narrow for a thousand forged identities to stand side by side at a discount. Each entry carries one signature, and every burn is published. Forging 1,000 identities costs 30,000 POA against a 12,000 POA epoch pool, while the nectar is far smaller than the faking cost. An honest agent pays once and keeps its full share.
